Class.summary: Controller responsible for user authentication, account registration, token lifecycle management, and profile retrieval.
Class.remarks: Implements JWT Bearer authentication with short-lived access tokens and database-backed refresh tokens. All validation and authentication errors return RFC 7807 ProblemDetails responses.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The MediatR mediator instance used for dispatching authentication commands and queries.
The service used to obtain the current authenticated user ID and role from JWT claims.

PostRegister.summary: Registers a new customer account in the system.
PostRegister.remarks: Public endpoint accessible to unauthenticated guests (NotAuthorized policy). Automatically assigns the Customer role to newly registered users. Password Requirements: Minimum 8 characters, at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit. Email & Username Uniqueness: Enforces unique email and username across the system.
PostRegister.param: The registration command containing username, email, phone number, password, and password confirmation.
PostRegister.returns: The registration result details including user ID, username, email, and assigned customer role.
PostRegister.response: Registration succeeded and the new customer account was created.
If input validation fails (e.g., passwords do not match, email format is invalid, phone contains non-digits, or password complexity rules are not met).
If an account with the specified email or username already exists.

PostLogin.summary: Authenticates user credentials and issues a signed JWT access token and refresh token.
PostLogin.remarks: Public endpoint accessible to unauthenticated guests (NotAuthorized policy). Validates email and password against ASP.NET Core Identity store. Generates a cryptographically secure JWT access token with role, ID, and email claims. Issues a database-stored refresh token with configurable expiration. Lockout Protection: Accounts are automatically locked out after 5 consecutive failed attempts.
PostLogin.param: The login payload containing user email and password credentials.
PostLogin.returns: An authentication response containing the JWT bearer access token, expiration datetime, and refresh token.
PostLogin.response: Authentication successful. Returns the JWT access token and refresh token.
If required fields are missing or email format is invalid.
If the email/password combination is incorrect.
If the account has been deactivated or disabled by an administrator.
If no user exists with the provided email.
If the user account is temporarily locked due to multiple consecutive failed login attempts.

RefreshToken.summary: Exchanges an expired JWT access token and a valid refresh token for a newly generated token pair.
RefreshToken.remarks: Public endpoint allowing clients to renew expired sessions without re-entering credentials. <list type="bullet"> <item><description>Validates the cryptographic signature of the expired JWT token (ignoring its lifetime).</description></item> <item><description>Verifies the provided refresh token matches the active token stored in the database and is not expired.</description></item> <item><description>Issues a new access token and a rotated refresh token to prevent replay attacks.</description></item> </list>
RefreshToken.param: The token renewal payload containing the expired access token and matching refresh token.
RefreshToken.returns: An authentication response containing the renewed JWT access token and updated refresh token.
RefreshToken.response: If the refresh token is missing, expired, revoked, or fails validation against the user account.
If the user associated with the token claims no longer exists.

PostLogout.summary: Terminates the authenticated user session and revokes the active refresh token.
PostLogout.remarks: Requires a valid Bearer token. <list type="bullet"> <item><description>Extracts the authenticated user ID from JWT claims.</description></item> <item><description>Clears the stored refresh token in the database, preventing future token renewals.</description></item> <item><description>Signs out the user session via Identity SignInManager.</description></item> </list>
PostLogout.response: Logout succeeded and refresh token revoked.
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token or the token has expired.

GetCurrentUser.summary: Retrieves the profile and account details of the currently authenticated user.
GetCurrentUser.remarks: Requires a valid Bearer token. Extracts user ID directly from JWT claims (NameIdentifier) and queries account status, display name, email, and assigned role.
GetCurrentUser.returns: The user profile response DTO containing user ID, display name, email, role, and active status.
GetCurrentUser.response: If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the user account could not be found in the database.
